title: 816. Race Car

examples.explanation: Drive forward twice: positions 1 then 3, using two A commands.
One shortest plan is A,A,R,A,A: overshoot to 7, reverse, then advance to 6.
A single forward move reaches the flag.

hints: Let n be the smallest run of A commands passing the flag (position 2^n - 1): either stop exactly or overshoot and come back.
Memoize results: overshooting costs n+1 plus the mirrored remainder; alternatively stop one step early and add a short forward burst.
